sources.limits: Hook deliveries can duplicate; hook session IDs do not establish exact resume authority.
Telemetry is opt-in, attributes may be omitted, and Claude's estimated cost is not provider billing authority.
Exact resume uses --resume with the retained native target; --continue is not a substitute.
Plugin list establishes installed and enabled status, not runtime loading.
Transcript locations are documented, but internal JSONL records are mutable and intentionally treated as opaque.
